get.description:
Get a list of Content Languages in the Joomla site.

Content-language IDs are numeric. Override IDs are constants matching [A-Z0-9_]+. The override write field is override, whereas responses use value. Override routes are generated for installed languages.

Saving an override reads app and lang_code from POST input. For POST, the API application puts route parameters into that input. For PATCH, route parameters are placed in the general input, so the client/language context is not guaranteed by the route and JSON body alone. Use the administrator override editor if PATCH cannot preserve the intended context.

Content-language lists use standard pagination. Override lists and string searches do not use the generic page[offset] and page[limit] slicing; check the operation-specific response. The base edit check requires core.manage and record core.edit, or core.edit.own with a matching owner; component overrides take precedence. Omitted SERVER_UTC/USER_UTC calendar values are restored from the stored UTC values after validation, avoiding a second timezone conversion.

BearerAuth.description: Joomla API token of a user, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Users get their token on the Joomla API Token tab of their profile. The plugins "API Authentication - Web Services Joomla Token" and "User - Joomla API Token" must be enabled.

JoomlaToken.name: X-Joomla-Token
JoomlaToken.description: The same API token in the `X-Joomla-Token` header. Joomla tries to extract a Bearer token first and reads this header when the extracted token is empty. A non-empty Bearer token takes precedence even when authentication fails.

BasicAuth.description: Username and password of a user. Only works when the plugin "API Authentication - Web Services Basic Auth" is enabled, which it is not by default.

JUpdateToken.name: X-JUpdate-Token
JUpdateToken.description: Update token of the Joomla Automated Updates service, set in the options of Joomla Update. Only used by the `/v1/joomlaupdate` endpoints.
